title: 第一卷 第97章 清剿第一卷 第96章 野狐
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
与关晶晶商议妥定之后，整个雁门关大营顿时行动起来。
李毅麾下的风虎营、破虏营皆回到了雁门关大营内，就连宋杰麾下的重骑兵营也自远方归来，一辆辆战车被从库房中推出。
至于雁门关附近的世家大族，更是在关将军的命令下，取出自家珍藏的粮草物资，以供大军交战。甚至就连陈国国内，也再次派出数支大军携带大量物资，来到雁门关内。
时至今日，青国与陈国之间的战斗，雁门关已经成了最为重要的一个节点。可以说，雁门关之地的胜负，影响着陈、青两国未来百年的命运。
三日后，李毅望着麾下的五千精锐大军，面露沉思。
此战，在李毅心中乃是自己晋升将军的至关一战，因此自己一定要打出军功战绩，继而晋升为将军。
抱着这般想法，李毅迈进中军大营，望向了关将军。
此时关将军正在处理诸多军务，宋杰等人也在大营之内，对着沙盘推演。
“李毅，你怎么来了？”关将军放下笔，抬头望向李毅。
闻言，李毅双手一拱，厉声对着关将军说道：
“将军，青国此次重来，必定有诸多后手。
上次他们派兵攻打秋风关与大散关，这一次他们卷土重来，未必不会又对此二关下手。”
听着李毅的话，关将军、宋杰等人皆是面露沉思。
大散关、秋风关之重要性，事关雁门关防线的组成，两关失，则雁门关防线出现破绽；雁门关失，则两关孤立无援，三关可谓是一荣俱荣，一损俱损。
正所谓高山流水遇知音，同频的人总是能很快明悟对方的意思。李毅这话一出，宋杰等人顿时明白了他的意思。
关将军道：
“听你的意思，难道你想去驻守这二关？”
李毅笑道：
“如今，青国黑风关在经历数次大战之后，早已元气大伤，此次即使来势汹汹，也定然后继无力。正因此，这一战我方乃是优势方，自然不能再和先前一样固守，故而属下认为，此战我等该主动出击。”
“主动出击？”

宋杰一愣，诧异地望向李毅。
大营内的诸多军官也皆是惊愕不已，即使李毅拥有李杀神的威名，对于他们来说主动出击也依然是一件险事。
青国靠着天工机巧，一直国力昌盛，在陈、青几国间一直都是最为强大之国，也正因此，他们才有胆子、有底气数次入侵陈国。
至于匈奴，靠着来无影去无踪的骑兵，更是长期打得陈国不敢出坚关。
面对众人的沉吟，李毅说道：
“我计划带领破虏营、风虎营五千精锐，在秋风关、大散关附近设伏清剿青国派出的大军。”
听着李毅的话，关将军慢慢敲击着桌子陷入了沉思，许久之后，关将军猛然一拍案桌，大声道：
“好！李毅说得对，哪有千日防贼的道理？既然青国敢入侵我们，那就要做好被我们攻打的准备。
李毅，本将军命你率本部兵马前往大散关、秋风关设伏，若战事有变，本将军许你随机应变之权。
另外，军中一切物资皆可由你取用。”
“放权？这是放权！”
众人听着关将军此言，顿时一惊。
便宜之权、资源任取等等，皆是彰显着关将军对李毅的宠爱与信任。
一时间，众人皆是惊愕、诧异，又带着期盼地望向李毅。
在众人的注视中，李毅不卑不亢，便道：
“请将军放心，属下必不负众望。”
随后李毅便领着令符离开了中军大营。
如今李毅麾下，韩甲统率破虏营，刘野、林雷等人统率风虎营。
不算青云宗弟子，如今李毅麾下已经有七位真气境战将。
在这些时日里，李毅已经将获得的【百胜诀】传给了麾下的真气境武者。时至今日，七位真气武者已经将功法转换为【百胜诀】，实力远胜从前。
content_en:
After discussing with Guan Jingjing, the entire Yanmen Pass Camp immediately took action.
Li Yi's Fenghu Camp and Polu Camp all returned to the Yanmen Pass camp. Even the heavy cavalry battalion under Song Jie also returned from afar, and tanks were pushed out of the warehouse one after another.
As for the aristocratic families near Yanmen Pass, under the order of General Guan, they took out their own treasures of grain and grass supplies for the army to fight. Even the Chen Kingdom once again sent several large armies carrying large amounts of supplies to Yanmen Pass.
To this day, Yanmen Pass has become the most important node in the battle between Qing State and Chen State. It can be said that the outcome of Yanmenguan will affect the fate of Chen and Qing in the next hundred years.
Three days later, Li Yi looked at the five thousand elite troops under his command, looking thoughtful.
This battle, in Li Yi's mind, is a crucial battle for him to be promoted to general, so he must achieve military success and then be promoted to general.
With this idea, Li Yi walked into the Chinese army camp and looked at General Guan.
At this time, General Guan was handling many military affairs, and Song Jie and others were also in the camp, conducting exercises on the sand table.
"Li Yi, why are you here?" General Guan put down his pen and looked up at Li Yi.
Hearing this, Li Yi arched his hands and said sternly to General Guan:
“General, when Qingguo comes back this time, it must have many backup plans.
Last time they sent troops to attack Qiufeng Pass and Dashan Pass. This time they make a comeback, and they may not attack these two passes again. "
Listening to Li Yi's words, General Guan, Song Jie and others all looked thoughtful.
The importance of Dashan Pass and Qiufeng Pass is related to the composition of Yanmen Pass's defense line. If two passes are lost, Yanmen Pass's defense line will have flaws; if Yanmen Pass is lost, the two passes will be isolated and helpless. It can be said that the three passes are prosperous and prosperous.
As the saying goes, when you meet a close friend in high mountains and flowing water, people who share the same frequency can always understand each other's meaning quickly. As soon as Li Yi said this, Song Jie and others immediately understood what he meant.
General Guan said:
"From what you say, do you want to guard these two levels?"
Li Yi smiled and said:
"Now, after experiencing several battles, Qingguo Heifeng Pass has long been severely weakened. Even if it comes fiercely this time, it will definitely be unable to follow up. Because of this, our side is the dominant side in this battle. Naturally, we can no longer hold on as before. Therefore, my subordinates believe that we should take the initiative in this battle."
"Take the initiative?"
Song Jie was stunned and looked at Li Yi in surprise.
Many officers in the camp were also shocked. Even if Li Yi had the reputation of Li Killing God, it would still be dangerous for them to take the initiative.
Relying on the ingenuity of heaven and earth, the Qing State has always been prosperous and has always been the most powerful country among the Chen and Qing countries. It is precisely because of this that they have the courage and confidence to invade the Chen State several times.
As for the Xiongnu, relying on the cavalry that came and went without a trace, they defeated Chen Guo for a long time and did not dare to leave the stronghold.
Facing everyone's silence, Li Yi said:
"I plan to lead five thousand elites from Polu Camp and Fenghu Camp to set up an ambush near Qiufeng Pass and Dashan Pass to suppress the Qing army sent by the Qing Kingdom."
Listening to Li Yi's words, General Guan slowly knocked on the table and fell into deep thought. After a long time, General Guan suddenly slammed the table and said loudly:
"Okay! Li Yi is right, how can you guard against thieves for a thousand days? Since the Qing Kingdom dares to invade us, it must be prepared to be attacked by us.
Li Yi, I have ordered you to lead your troops to Dashan Pass and Qiufeng Pass to set up ambushes. If the war situation changes, I will give you the right to adapt accordingly.
In addition, all supplies in the army are available to you. "
"Delegating power? This is delegating power!"
Everyone was shocked when they heard what General Guan said.
The right to gain advantage, access to resources at will, etc. all demonstrate General Guan's love and trust in Li Yi.
For a moment, everyone was shocked, surprised, and looked at Li Yi expectantly.
Under the gaze of everyone, Li Yi was neither humble nor arrogant, and said:
"General, please rest assured, my subordinates will live up to expectations."Then Li Yi led the order talisman and left the Chinese army camp.
Now under Li Yi's command, Han Jia leads Polu Camp, and Liu Ye, Lin Lei and others command Fenghu Camp.
Not counting the Qingyun Sect disciples, Li Yi now has seven Zhenqi realm warriors under his command.
During these days, Li Yi has passed on the [Hundred Victory Technique] he obtained to the Zhenqi realm warriors under his command. Today, the seven Zhenqi warriors have converted their skills into the [Hundred Victory Technique], and their strength is far greater than before.
